fields.zh:
毕业之后，你有多久没有和 Monash 校友一起，坐下来安心打一下午牌？
也许我们毕业于不同年份，来自不同专业，如今也走向不同的行业。
但这一次——不需要准备正式的 Networking 话题，也不需要提前认识任何人。

洗好牌，发到手，游戏就开始了。

上周六，「校友桌游月」首场狼人杀专场已经开局。现在，第二场如约而至：
fields.en:
How long has it been since you sat down with fellow Monash alumni for a relaxed afternoon of cards?
We may have graduated in different years, studied different subjects and gone into different industries. This time, there is no need to prepare formal networking topics or know anyone beforehand.
Shuffle, deal and let the games begin.
Last Saturday, Alumni Board Game Month opened with a Werewolf session. Now it is time for the second gathering.

fields.zh: 【MCSA资讯】2026国际学生招聘博览会（International Student Career Expo）正式启动
fields.en: MCSA News | The 2026 International Student Career Expo launches
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh:
对于在澳国际学生而言，求职路上最大的挑战之一，是许多岗位对在澳身份设有限制。花费大量时间投递申请，却可能最终发现自己并不在招聘范围之内。
这是许多国际学生共同面对的问题，也是我们举办本次博览会的初衷
正因如此，本次博览会的所有参展企业均对国际学生开放招聘，部分企业更具备提供签证担保的资质与意愿。我们希望每一位到场的同学，都能将时间与精力投入到真正属于自己的机会之中。
2026国际学生招聘博览会（International Student Career Expo）致力于为国际学生搭建专业、高效的求职对接平台。现场设有招聘展位与信息咨询台，汇聚40余家知名企业、政府机构及专业组织，让同学们与招聘负责人面对面交流，了解招聘需求，获取一手职业信息，探索更多实习与就业机会。
无论您处于职业规划的哪个阶段，本次博览会都将为您提供宝贵的信息与机遇。诚挚邀请各位同学踊跃参与。
2026国际学生招聘博览会组委会
fields.en:
One of the biggest challenges for international students seeking work in Australia is that many roles have residency restrictions. After spending time applying, students may discover they are not eligible. This shared experience is why we created this expo.
All exhibitors are recruiting international students, and some have the ability and willingness to offer visa sponsorship. We want students to focus their time and energy on opportunities open to them.
The 2026 International Student Career Expo offers a professional platform to connect students with employers. Recruitment booths and information desks bring together more than 40 companies, government agencies and professional organisations. Meet recruiters, learn about their requirements, get first-hand career information and explore internships and jobs.
Whatever stage you are at in your career planning, we warmly invite you to take part.
2026 International Student Career Expo Organising Committee

fields.zh: 【MCSA资讯】清电澳行丨参访蒙纳士大学
fields.en: MCSA News | Tsinghua Electrical Engineering students visit Monash University
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh:
8月21日，清华大学电机系“清电澳行”赴澳大利亚实践支队走进蒙纳士大学克莱顿校区，与蒙纳士大学中国学生会成员及在校中国学生开展座谈交流和校园参访，在思想碰撞与实地探访中感受多元校园文化，了解澳大利亚高校的人才培养方式与工程创新生态。
蒙纳士大学创立于1958年，克莱顿校区是学校最早设立且规模最大的校区。这里集中了工程、科学、医学等多个学科的教学科研资源。2026年QS世界大学学科排名中，蒙纳士大学药学与药理学位列全球第二。支队在参访中既了解了学校的学科与培养体系，也通过同龄人的讲述观察海外校园中真实的学习与生活。
fields.en:
On 21 August, the “Qingdian Australia” student delegation from Tsinghua University’s Department of Electrical Engineering visited Monash University’s Clayton campus. They met MCSA members and Chinese students for discussions and a campus tour, exploring campus diversity, approaches to education and engineering innovation in Australia.
Founded in 1958, Monash has its oldest and largest campus at Clayton, with teaching and research across engineering, science, medicine and other disciplines. In the 2026 QS subject rankings, Monash placed second worldwide for pharmacy and pharmacology. The visit introduced the delegation to the university’s disciplines and education system, while conversations with peers offered a view of everyday study and life overseas.

百万英才汇南粤”

千万别错过这场专属盛会
fields.en: The autumn doctoral talent gathering “Baibo Xing · Ben Guangming”, part of the “Million Talents in Guangdong” initiative, is now open. Connect with employers and visit Guangming Science City to explore research careers and city life. The programme combines public-sector recruitment examinations, on-site hiring and study visits.

fields.zh: 【MCSA资讯】【免费参会·火热征稿】参会礼品抢先看！｜第十六届优秀青年学者论文报告会征稿启事
fields.en: MCSA News | Free attendance and call for papers: The 16th Young Scholars’ Research Symposium — preview the attendee gifts
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh:
026年，澳大利亚中国博士沙龙（CAPS）迎来成立二十周年的重要历史时刻。值此之际，CAPS诚挚邀请广大博士生、博士后、青年学者及科研工作者积极投稿，参加第十六届澳大利亚博士生及青年学者优秀论文报告会，共同分享最新科研成果，促进跨学科交流与合作，携手探索未来科技创新与社会发展的新机遇。
本届大会将汇聚来自澳大利亚及国际高校、科研院所和产业界的优秀青年学者，为大家提供展示研究成果、拓展学术合作、促进科研创新的高水平交流平台。
fields.en:
In 2026, CAPS (澳大利亚中国博士沙龙) marks its 20th anniversary. CAPS invites doctoral students, postdoctoral researchers, young scholars and research professionals to submit papers to its 16th symposium for doctoral students and young scholars. Share new findings, build interdisciplinary connections and explore opportunities in innovation and social development.
The conference will bring together young scholars from Australian and international universities, research institutes and industry to present research, develop collaborations and support innovation.
fields.reviewNote: Confirm the organisation’s preferred English name and the year, written as 026 in the Chinese source.

fields.zh: 【26S2 Welcome Party】新生欢迎会｜多重好礼等你拿

一起认识新朋友，开启你的墨尔本生活!

兴趣分组·趣味游戏·茶歌交流找到志同道合的新朋友，开启属于你的校园社交圈!
fields.en: Meet new friends and begin your Melbourne life! What better way to settle into a new city than a relaxed Welcome Party? Interest groups, fun games and conversations over tea and music will help you meet like-minded people and build your campus social circle.

fields.en: Arriving somewhere new can feel unfamiliar. At this Welcome Party, smiles, conversations and group photos helped us get to know one another.

fields.zh: 【MCSA资讯】｜AI创业大赛·德邻杯2026

fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.en: The Delin Cup 2026 AI Entrepreneurship Competition has opened. It is organised by Delin Capital, guided by the science and technology innovation bureau of Shenzhen’s Longhua District, and supported by the Shenzhen Angel Fund of Funds.

fields.zh: 【MCSA活动】校友桌游月 · 第一场：狼人杀专场正式开启！
fields.en: MCSA Events | Alumni Board Game Month, Session 1: Werewolf
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh:
我们知道，并不是每一位校友都是狼人杀资深玩家。因此第一期特别定位为「新手友好场」。正式游戏开始前，主持人会进行完整的规则说明、角色确认与游戏流程讲解，
现场工作人员也会全程协助引导。这不仅不是一场高压的高手竞技局，更是属于 Monash 校友的一次轻松解压社交。
fields.en: Not every alumnus is an experienced Werewolf player, so our first session is designed to welcome beginners. Before play begins, the host will explain the rules, roles and game flow, with staff on hand throughout. This is a relaxed opportunity for Monash alumni to socialise and unwind.

fields.zh: 【MCSA活动】【轻社交交友｜午夜信号局】在蓝色夜晚，寻找与你同频的信号
fields.en: MCSA Events | Blue Signal: Find Your Connection After Dark
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh: 城市入夜，人群来来往往。 我们每天接收到无数讯息，却不一定能遇见真正同频的人。  这个夜晚，我们想把社交变得简单一点。  不用准备完美的开场白，也不用担心不知道该和陌生人聊什么。 来到 Blue Signal 午夜信号局，领取属于你的今晚信号，在游戏、音乐和互动中，让一次偶然的相遇自然发生。
fields.en: Night falls and people pass through the city. We receive countless messages every day, but meeting someone on the same wavelength can be harder. For this evening, we want to make socialising simple. There is no need for a perfect opening line or a prepared conversation. Join Blue Signal, pick up your signal for the night, and let games, music and interaction create new connections.

fields.zh: 【MCSA资讯】聚焦丨“留学生的故事”有奖征集评选活动启动
fields.en: MCSA News | “Stories of International Students” opens for prize submissions
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh: 为深入贯彻落实习近平总书记致欧美同学会成立110周年重要贺信精神，充分发挥广大海外留学生“行走的中国名片”作用，《留学生》杂志社面向海外中国留学生开展“留学生的故事”有奖征集评选活动，旨在以留学生独特视角向世界讲述真实、立体、全面的中国故事。
fields.en: Following President Xi Jinping’s congratulatory letter on the 110th anniversary of the Western Returned Scholars Association, the magazine “International Students” is inviting Chinese students overseas to enter its “Stories of International Students” competition. The initiative aims to recognise students as representatives of China abroad and share authentic, multidimensional stories of China through their perspectives.

fields.zh: 【MCSA资讯】欢迎来到蒙纳士！在国际学生日，开启你的墨尔本之旅
fields.en: MCSA News | Welcome to Monash: Begin your Melbourne journey at International Student Day
fields.reviewNote: Event titles are descriptive translations; confirm official wording with the organiser.

fields.zh:
你在澳大利亚的旅程即将开始!非常期待你在下周走进蒙纳士校园际学生精心设计的全天迎新体验
作为国际学生想要快速了解蒙纳士大学的学习生活?我们诚邀你参加国际学生日，这是一场为国
这个活动将帮助你快速适应新环境、了解签证要求、结识志同道合的新朋友，让你从入学第一天
就充满自信。这是开启你墨尔本生活最完美的方式。
fields.en: Your Australian journey is about to begin, and we look forward to welcoming you to Monash next week. International Student Day is a full-day orientation experience designed to help international students discover university life. Learn how to settle in, understand visa requirements and meet new friends, so you can feel confident from your first day and begin your Melbourne experience.

fields.zh: 【MCSA回顾】活动回顾｜首个全澳行前会！澳大利亚高校中国新生线上行前交流会圆满举行！

fields.zh: 2026年5月23日，蒙纳士校友茶话会圆满举办。近40位在校学子、毕业校友齐聚线下，以轻社交为载体，搭建经验互通、资源对接的校友交流平台，整场活动轻松无压力，兼具交流温度与实用干货。
fields.en: On 23 May 2026, nearly 40 current students and graduates came together for the Monash Alumni Tea Gathering. In a relaxed setting, participants exchanged experiences and connections, combining friendly conversation with practical insights.

fields.zh: 【MCSA活动回顾】蒙纳士校友会｜《友说远川》香港篇——“升学·就业·身份”线上分享会

fields.en: MCSA’s “Alumni Perspectives” online session on Hong Kong concluded with useful insights and lively discussion. For those who could not attend, we have collected highlights on further study, residency and employment to help alumni plan their next steps.
